name: openreading-docling-local-preview
description: Read local document evidence with physical page citations.
long_description:
Local development preview for macOS on Apple Silicon. Choose a document directory; enable OCR explicitly to read scanned text. The bundled slim Docling runtime performs extraction locally and retains source copies and evidence until you remove its store. Requested document content enters your assistant's context. The folder grant limits OpenReading tools, not other assistant tools. Resource limits are reported by the import tool. No passwords, hosted fallback, or measured token-savings claim. This candidate is not a signed public release.

OpenReading Managed: Coming soon
Document processing on OpenReading's servers, without managing local compute. Planned after the public OSS launch.

OCR text can differ from the printed page, including letters and digits. Exact identifier searches may miss evidence. Verify important OCR quotes against the source page; citations verify extracted text, not transcription accuracy.

The launcher disables ONNX Runtime telemetry before the document engine starts.

input_root.title: Document directory
input_root.description: Allow OpenReading to read documents in this directory. Source copies are retained locally; requested document content enters your assistant's context.

ocr.title: Read scanned text (OCR)
ocr.description: Enable local Tesseract OCR for text stored in page images. This uses additional time and memory. OCR evidence is labeled in citations. OCR can misread letters and digits, so exact identifier searches may miss evidence. Verify important quotes against the printed page.

tools.name: openreading_import
tools.description: Retain one granted document using local Docling and the configured OCR setting.

tools.name: openreading_search
tools.description: Search bounded retained page evidence with literal words.

tools.name: openreading_read
tools.description: Read exact returned evidence with physical pages and text origins.

tools.name: openreading_select_document
tools.description: Choose a local document when the launcher supplies a trusted picker; otherwise returns selection_unavailable.

tools.name: openreading_get_document
tools.description: Read the complete retained normalized result with bounded continuation, existing structure, origins and citation references; no raw provider payloads.

tools.name: openreading_start_import
tools.description: Start local document processing in the background.

tools.name: openreading_get_import
tools.description: Check processing status, elapsed time and the finished document receipt.
